title: Sober Companion in Los Angeles, CA | California Treatment Centers
desc: Vetted sober companion and sober transport services across Los Angeles County — live-in, on-call and travel. What to ask before you hire. Call 213-321-6518.
h1: Sober Companion Services in Los Angeles
bodyHtml:
Los Angeles has more sober companions available than any city in the United States, and almost no way for a family to tell the excellent ones from the opportunistic ones. The market grew alongside the region's treatment industry, it is entirely unregulated, and it operates largely on referral and reputation. If you are trying to arrange support for someone here, the difficulty is not finding options — it is evaluating them.

We help people across Los Angeles County arrange vetted sober companionship: the Westside, the San Fernando Valley, the South Bay, Downtown, Pasadena and the San Gabriel Valley, and out to the Santa Clarita and Conejo Valleys.

Why Los Angeles Is Its Own Case

Careers That Cannot Absorb an Absence

A significant share of demand here comes from people whose work makes conventional aftercare genuinely impractical — entertainment and production schedules, touring, professional sport, executives with visible roles. These are people who cannot disappear for ninety days, and for whom being recognised in a group room is a real professional risk rather than a rationalisation. Companionship is one of the few forms of support that travels with the work, onto a set or a tour, which is precisely why it took hold in this city.

The Driving Problem

Los Angeles is a car city, and that shapes early recovery in specific ways. Someone who has lost a licence to a DUI faces a genuine logistics crisis around getting to IOP, work and meetings. Someone who has kept their licence has complete unsupervised mobility from day one — hours alone in a car, and the entire county reachable. Both situations are harder here than in a city with functioning transit, and both are common reasons families reach for a companion.

Distance Is a Clinical Variable

A companion based in Santa Monica covering someone in Pasadena is making a real commitment in traffic, and it affects reliability at exactly the moments that matter. When we arrange support, geography is part of the match — not a detail to sort out later.

Alcohol Is Everywhere in the Work

Networking here happens over drinks with unusual consistency: premieres, wrap parties, industry dinners, pitch meetings. For someone whose career depends on being present at those events, avoidance is not a viable long-term plan. A large part of a companion's work in Los Angeles is rehearsing and then physically accompanying someone through professional events they cannot skip.

Common Situations We See in Los Angeles

  • Stepping down from treatment. Los Angeles and Orange County hold one of the densest concentrations of residential treatment in the country, and a great many people finish a program here and stay. The handover home is the highest-risk moment in the process.
  • Production and touring. A companion travelling with someone through a shoot or a tour, managing schedule, sleep and the surrounding environment.
  • Students. UCLA, USC and the region's other universities generate steady demand for discreet support that lets someone stay enrolled rather than withdraw for a semester.
  • Court-involved situations. Where a DUI or diversion program requires demonstrated compliance, documented support and reliable attendance carry real weight.
  • Family exhaustion. Families who have been supervising a relative themselves for months and cannot sustain it any longer without damage to their own health and work.
  • Sober transport. Accompanying someone to a facility — locally, to LAX, or on a flight — frequently arranged at very short notice.

Vetting a Companion in Los Angeles

“Sober companion” is not a licensed profession in California — no state board, no examination, no registry. Anyone may use the title. In a market this large that matters more here than anywhere else in the country, because volume attracts operators who are selling access rather than expertise.

Before anyone starts, get four things: the individual's name and credentials (not the agency's), the background-check policy in writing, proof of insurance and who employs them, and the confidentiality terms on paper — an independent companion may not be a HIPAA covered entity, so your protection is whatever the contract says. Ask who provides clinical supervision and what the escalation path is at 3am.

Our guide to sober companionship sets out the full checklist, including the voluntary credentials worth asking for — California Peer Support Specialist certification through DHCS, CCAR recovery coach training, and CCAPP or CADTP counsellor certification.

One Los Angeles-Specific Warning

The scale of the treatment market here has historically supported a layer of referral intermediaries paid per placement — the arrangement California's patient brokering laws were written to address. Ask directly: is anyone receiving a fee for referring me to this companion or this program? A straight answer is the minimum you should accept, from us included.

What It Costs in Los Angeles

Sober companionship is rarely covered by insurance — it is generally classified as non-clinical support rather than treatment, so it is almost always private pay. Los Angeles rates sit at the higher end of the national range, and quoting a figure without knowing the situation would be guesswork.

What protects you is asking for a written fee schedule before committing: the daily or hourly rate, the minimum engagement, whether overnight hours are covered or billed separately, travel and mileage, agency placement fees, and cancellation terms. How companionship pricing is structured explains what each of those normally means.

If cost is the barrier, say so early. Structured sober living paired with IOP delivers much of the same accountability for considerably less, is frequently insurance-eligible, and is the better answer for more people than companionship is.

How It Fits With Treatment in Los Angeles

Companionship is a bridge, not a destination. For most people here the sensible structure pairs a companion with ongoing clinical care — IOP or outpatient treatment, and medication-assisted treatment where opioids are involved. Los Angeles has deep resources in all of these; see addiction treatment across Los Angeles County for how the wider picture fits together. For some people structured sober living is the better and considerably cheaper answer, and we will say so if that is what we think.

Arranging Support in Los Angeles

Call 213-321-6518 for a confidential conversation. We will ask what is actually going on, be direct about whether companionship is the right tool, and help arrange properly vetted support across Los Angeles County if it is. If something less expensive would serve better, we will tell you that instead.

If someone is in immediate danger or having thoughts of suicide, call or text 988 now. If someone may be overdosing, call 911. Naloxone is available without a prescription at California pharmacies.

faq.q: How quickly can a sober companion start in Los Angeles?
faq.a: Often within 24 hours, and sometimes the same day for urgent situations such as a discharge or sober transport to a facility. Availability depends on the format — a live-in placement with a specific profile takes longer to match well than on-call support. Call 213-321-6518 and we will tell you honestly what is realistic.

faq.q: Do sober companions travel from Los Angeles for work trips or productions?
faq.a: Yes — this is one of the most common reasons people in Los Angeles engage a companion. The arrangement is normally the standard daily rate plus the companion's travel and accommodation expenses. Agree the full cost structure in writing beforehand, including travel time.

faq.q: Is sober companionship confidential in Los Angeles?
faq.a: It should be, but check what you are actually getting. An independent companion may not be a HIPAA covered entity, so your protection is whatever the written agreement provides. Ask for the confidentiality terms in writing before anyone starts, particularly if professional exposure is a concern.

faq.q: How much does a sober companion cost in Los Angeles?
faq.a: Los Angeles rates sit at the higher end of the national range and vary widely with experience and format. Rather than quote a figure blind, ask any provider for a written fee schedule covering the daily or hourly rate, minimum engagement, overnight coverage, travel and transport charges, and cancellation terms. If cost is a barrier, sober living plus IOP delivers much of the same accountability for considerably less and is often insurance-eligible.

faq.q: Do you have companions across all of Los Angeles County?
faq.a: We help arrange support across the county — Westside, San Fernando Valley, South Bay, Downtown, Pasadena and the San Gabriel Valley, and the Santa Clarita and Conejo Valleys. Because traffic materially affects reliability, we treat the companion's home base relative to yours as part of the match rather than an afterthought.

faq.q: Can a sober companion help someone who refuses treatment?
faq.a: Sometimes, as a first step. For someone unwilling to enter a program, a companion is occasionally the only support they will accept, and that relationship can become the route to treatment later. Be clear-eyed about it though: this works when the person is ambivalent, not when they are wholly unwilling. If there is immediate medical danger, that needs emergency care, not companionship.
